title: Consume European color-mode indexed archives
changes: Publish three authenticated color-mode indexed archives in E204-d203, preserving guest selection and decoding and retaining the existing physical owner of four overlapping bytes.
Bind the split source ranges to the existing indexed graphics resource and preserve all prior resources and the prior indexed data.
validation: Windows test build e212-indexed-build-9a9mmz_a and Wine e212-indexed-wine-d88bld36 pass: 495 programs, all source bytes, mixed boundaries and mirrors, five original interpreted and translated reader cases, authentication and retained-owner checks.

Wine e212-home-scene-wine-t6q5y978 matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio across 600 recorded home frames with the first archive altered; programs 125, 127 and 129 are consumed.

Windows production build e212-cli-build-lg3nx6if and Wine e212-indexed-cli-wine-vnsgav7l pass create/reuse/verify with 124 files matching the tested dataset. Wine servers drain and the local overlay avoids the D-Bus assertion. Static e212-home-residual-ucws8f95 leaves 2126 of 8544 sampled bytes unowned.
limitations: Other consumers, color modes and scenes, real-BIOS and UI save/Load paths remain open. Linux, USA and native Windows require separate verification. No performance comparisons were performed.
